name: Petty Squabbles
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
We fight the wrong enemy, adventurer.

The true power in these lands continues to grow in strength and number while we squabble over scorched earth with orcs.

Do we continue to fight a war in these lands against the Horde, only to be routed one day by the armies of the Burning Legion? It is futile.

Put your differences aside, adventurer, speak with the fallen hero of the Horde. He knows the truth behind the Blasted Lands.
narrative.objectives: Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the border of the Blasted Lands and the swamp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The Alliance wishes to assist?

I thought to never see this day again. A day in which the Alliance fights side by side with the Horde against a common enemy.

It shall be... we will unite.

chain.subtitle: 19 quests from level 57 to 60, 89,775 XP in all.

quests.name: Petty Squabbles
quests.objectiveText: Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the border of the Blasted Lands and the swamp.

quests.name: A Tale of Sorrow
quests.objectiveText: Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.

quests.name: The Stones That Bind Us
quests.objectiveText: Free nine Servants of Razelikh, three Servants of Sevine, three Servants of Allistarj, and three Servants of Grol.

quests.name: Heroes of Old
quests.objectiveText: Open the chest and claim your reward.

quests.name: Kirith
quests.objectiveText: Find out what became of Lieutenant Kirith.

quests.name: The Cover of Darkness
quests.objectiveText: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde with your findings.

quests.name: The Demon Hunter
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in Azshara.

quests.name: Loramus
quests.objectiveText: Listen to Loramus Thalipedes tell his story.

quests.name: Breaking the Ward
quests.objectiveText: Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.

quests.name: The Name of the Beast
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara.

quests.name: The Name of the Beast
quests.objectiveText: Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.

quests.name: The Name of the Beast
quests.objectiveText: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.

quests.name: Azsharite
quests.objectiveText: Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara.

quests.name: The Formation of Felbane
quests.objectiveText: Take the Shipment to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.

quests.name: Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry
quests.objectiveText: Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.

quests.name: Return to the Blasted Lands
quests.objectiveText: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

quests.name: Uniting the Shattered Amulet
quests.objectiveText: Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj.

quests.name: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
quests.objectiveText: Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
